# lili policies

> Draft awaiting review by a UAE lawyer. It describes how lili works today; the Arabic version will be the one that counts once it is published.

The same text is in the app (Profile → Privacy & Safety → All policies) and in `app/web/policies/` for hosting.

- [Terms of Use](terms.md): The agreement between you and lili: who can use it, what lili does and doesn't do, and what happens if the rules are broken.
- [Privacy Notice](privacy.md): What lili holds about you, why, who else handles it, how long it's kept, and your rights over it.
- [Seller Policy](seller.md): What you agree to when you open a shop: you are the seller, what you may list, how to describe it, and what buyers are owed.
- [Prohibited & Restricted Items](prohibited.md): What can never be listed on lili, and why.
- [Authenticity & Intellectual Property](authenticity.md): lili's position on counterfeits, what lili does and doesn't check, and how brand owners report infringement.
- [Community Guidelines](community.md): How to treat each other on lili.
- [Meeting & Safety](safety.md): How to hand a piece over safely in person, and what to do if something goes wrong.
- [Payments & Scams](payments.md): lili doesn't handle money. How payment works between members, and how to spot a scam.
- [Offers & Reservations](offers.md): How offers, counter-offers and reservations work.
- [Reviews & Trust Signals](reviews.md): Who can review whom, and how the trust signals on shops are earned.
- [Reports, Strikes & Appeals](moderation.md): How reports are handled, how strikes work, and how to appeal a decision.
- [Account Deletion & Data Retention](deletion.md): How to delete your account, what is removed, and what is kept and for how long.
